name: binary_cross_entropy
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::binary_cross_entropy(Tensor self, Tensor target, Tensor? weight=None, int reduction=Mean) -> Tensor. Computes elementwise binary cross entropy with optional weighting and none, mean, or sum reduction without mutating or aliasing its inputs. Tests cover legacy reduction shapes, zero-sized tensors, weighted and unweighted calls, exact probability boundaries, the related out overload's contents and object/storage identity, functional and ATen calling conventions, gradients, and input non-mutation.
